description: Destroy a sandbox and release its GPU resources. Irreversible. DESTRUCTIVE — call once with dry_run: true to receive a confirm_token, then call again with that token to execute.

confirm_token.description: Confirm token returned by a prior dry_run call. Required for destructive tools.

dry_run.description: If true, validate inputs and return a planned action + confirm_token without mutating state. Call again with the returned confirm_token to execute.

name: cp_sandbox_destroy
